description: What is on in one city over the coming days: for each event its name, the venue, the date and time, and a link to the listing. Concerts, festivals, sport, markets — whatever the city's own newsroom has announced.

city.description: city slug from list_cities, e.g. pattaya or dubai

edition.description: edition key from list_editions: ru | th | ae | sa | tw

limit.description: how many events to return, up to 20 (default 10)

name: city_events
